recommendations.title: Refresh: Guide comparing AC‑coupled vs DC‑coupled systems for EV charging
recommendations.details: Expand the inverter/battery guide to explicitly compare AC‑coupled and DC‑coupled architectures in scenarios that include an EV charger. Explain how each affects: simultaneous PV, battery and EV power flows; peak power limits; whether existing PV inverters must be replaced; and typical control approaches for prioritising self‑consumption vs vehicle charging. Include short decision rules for homeowners (when to choose DC vs AC) and mention consequences for mains fuse and need for load balancing.

recommendations.title: Create: End‑to‑end system example pages with diagrams
recommendations.details: Publish 1–2 case pages showing concrete system builds (e.g., Easee or Zaptec charger + LFP home battery + hybrid inverter, and an alternative AC‑coupled variant). Each case should include wiring/architecture diagrams, list of components, communication protocols used (e.g., Modbus, OCPP, vendor APIs), commissioning steps, and expected behaviour (solar priority, battery reserve, charger limits). This will help customers visualise real installations and understand installation scope.

recommendations.title: Refresh: Laddbox service page with compatibility checklist and cost impacts
recommendations.details: Extend the Laddboxar service page to include a compatibility checklist for pairing with home batteries and solar (required inverter features, metering, communication), plus a short section on typical extra costs (metering equipment, lastbalansering hardware, potential huvudsäkringshöjning) and how these affect ROI. Add a prompt to book a combined hembesök for both charger and battery sizing.
